purpose: Thin wrapper around user32 LockWorkStation to lock the Windows session programmatically.
called_by: TrayAppContext.cs — called after an idle-triggered launched app exits when LockPcOnAppClose is true
invariants: Returns false with a non-empty errorMessage on any failure
Never throws — all Win32 errors and exceptions are captured and returned via errorMessage
gotchas: LockWorkStation requires the calling process to have an interactive session — will silently fail if called from a service context
